programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: (2020) Fighty, satirical horror that upset Donald Trump. Hilary Swank plays a rich lefty who likes hunting working class people to the death. But she didn't reckon on Betty Gilpin.

programme.title: The Worst Person in the World
programme.desc: (2021) Romantic drama. A young woman grapples with her desires. Will her search for the perfect life leave her missing out? In Norwegian/subs. Adults only: strong language/sex/drugs/nudity.

programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: (1997) Family fantasy comedy-adventure starring Jim Broadbent and Celia Imrie. A family of miniscule people live beneath the floorboards of a regular-sized family's house.

programme.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
programme.desc: (1984) It's time to put on make-up. It's time to light the lights. Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzy, the Blues one and the gang embark on a musical adventure as they try to make it on Broadway.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: (2001) Scary sci-fi comedy. Can David Duchovny, Julianne Moore and Orlando Jones save humanity from a rapidly evolving, predatory alien species? Well, DD used to be Fox Mulder, so...

programme.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
programme.desc: (2008) Remake of the sci-fi classic with Keanu Reeves. An alien visits Earth to tell humankind to stop destroying the planet. But when he's attacked, he decides to eradicate us instead...

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends: One and All
programme.desc: (2022) Sea-shanty-singing comedy sequel with James Purefoy. The band are on tour but it's not all plain sailing. The label want Jim to replace his dead dad and Leadville just ain't woke.

programme.title: Deadpool 2
programme.desc: (2018) Ryan Reynolds returns as the potty-mouthed, can of whup-ass-opening superhero and now he's got buddies to help him take on baddie Josh Brolin in the all-out action comedy sequel.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: (2018) Tom Cruise stars in part six of the action-thriller series. His mission: to stop terrorists from getting their hands on nuclear bombs and unleashing global devastation.

programme.title: Funny Pages
programme.desc: (2022) Dark, adults-only, coming-of-age comedy about a troubled schoolboy who quits education to become a comic book artist - with the help of an array of questionable older men...

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: (1997) Animated drama. When the Russian royal family is murdered, the sole surviving child is separated from her grandmother. Years later, conmen try to exploit the reward for her return.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: (2006) Spooky animated caper with Maggie Gyllenhaal and Steve Buscemi. A young boy and his babysitter spy on the creepy neighbour. Did he really eat his wife?

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: (1994) Festive family drama. Richard Attenborough stars as a department store Santa who insists he's the real Santa Claus. But can he prove it in court?

programme.title: The Devil Wears Prada
programme.desc: (2006) Comedy-drama starring Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep. A naive young woman lands a job as assistant to one of New York's most important, but ruthless and cynical, magazine editors.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: (2004) All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programme.title: See How They Run
programme.desc: (2022) Sam Rockwell and Saoirse Ronan head a splendid ensemble for this comedy whodunnit that places a real murder among a production of Agatha Christie's The Mousetrap. With Adrien Brody.

programme.title: Last Night in Soho

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick begins his search for quality produce in the beautiful Northumberland countryside. Later, he shares his recipe for a tasty moussaka with aubergines. S2, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick visits a food festival in the Yorkshire Dales, where he gets inspiration to make a curd cheese tart. Plus, he checks out a wonderful organic veg garden. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick shares his recipe for fresh crayfish with chopped tomatoes, basil and spaghetti. Plus, he gets a food tour of Ludlow from talented chef Shaun Hill. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick learns about a world-famous sticky toffee pudding that's made in the Lake District. Plus, he joins two fishermen as they catch sea trout on the River Towy. S2, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick admires the quality produce on offer at the English Market in Cork, Ireland. He is inspired to cook corned beef with potatoes, carrots and cabbage. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: After visiting an award-winning herb grower, Rick uses fresh ingredients to make a delicious pork terrine. And, he samples oatcakes in Stoke-on-Trent. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick gathers butchers from Smithfield Market to see whether they can taste the difference between organic and non-organic beef. Plus, he cooks beef stroganoff. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick and Chalky go fishing for large langoustines on Loch Torridon. And, he travels to the Cotswolds to explore a farm that grows enormous cooking apples. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick goes reef fishing for sea bass in the Channel Island of Jersey, before enjoying a beach barbecue. Later, he goes pheasant shooting in Cornwall. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein is in Cornwall to meet a fish merchant who has helped make pilchards popular again. Plus, he visits a successful food festival in Wales. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick travels to Ayrshire to meet the butchers behind a world-famous bacon. Plus, he reveals his recipe for lamb koftas with yoghurt and salad. S2, Ep11

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Lord Coke invites Rick and Chalky to go partridge shooting in Norfolk. Plus, Rick rediscovers traditional favourites like Kentish cobnuts and quinces. S2, Ep12

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: The Patient Cook. Chef Asma Khan celebrates being a patient cook with slow cooked kosha mangsho, a divine duck bhuna, veg filled parathas and an incredible dessert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: The Classics. Chef Asma Khan enjoys timeless Indian classics, from a delicious dal and jhal farezi to tangy aloo gobi matter and historic 1st Class Railway Curry. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Tangra: Kolkata's China Town. Chef Asma Khan's recipes are inspired by Kolkata's Chinatown. They include chicken, chilli steak with spicy mash and mouthwatering Tangra prawns. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet Things. Chef Asma Khan showcases the beauty of Indian desserts, with fragrant kheer, a spiced bread and butter pudding, a chocolate treat and banana fritters. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Of Rice And Bread. Rice and bread dishes are popular, especially the aloo paratha. Asma Kahn cooks prawn biryani, friendship rotis made to share and a syrupy sweet. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Finding Flavour. Chef Asma Khan celebrates herbs and marinades. Fenugreek methi chicken, the hariyali baked version, and mouth-watering tamarind prawns. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Sumptuous Snacks. Chef Asma Khan makes spiced Kabab Burgers, crispy monsoon pakoras, flavourful koftas and indulgent chilli cheese toasties - perfect sumptuous snacks. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Star Vegetables. Chef Asma Khan celebrates vegetables with Shimla mirch paneer, 9 jewel korma, pumpkin niramish and a delicious watermelon curry - a feast of spices. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Street Food. Chef Asma Khan celebrates the joy of street food, featuring chicken momos, potato and sweetcorn patties, lamb 'jali' kabab and paneer skewers. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Best Of Bengal. Asma loves cooking Bengali influenced food. On the menu is her mother's prawn malaikari, an omelette curry, a rich fish curry, and a coconut dessert. S1, Ep10

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Lancashire. James continues his adventure in Lancashire with chef Lisa Allen. They visit Lisa's hometown, Clitheroe, where they prepare a lovely John Dory dish. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Snowdonia. James heads to North Wales with Stephen Terry. They have a five-star meal at Pale Hall, then James cooks Welsh lamb with gnocchi. S1, Ep7

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Pembrokeshire. James and Stephen are heading south through Wales en route to Pembrokeshire. They visit Michelin-starred restaurant Ynyshir, run by chef Gareth Ward. S1, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Northern Irish Coast. James explores Northern Ireland with famous local chef Paul Rankin. James cooks up a delicious dish that celebrates the amazing seafood on offer. S1, Ep9

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Belfast. James Martin and Paul Rankin head to Paul's hometown, Belfast. There, he gives James a personal tour of Northern Ireland's capital city. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sicilian And Seafood. Guy goes to Oklahoma City to test out the offerings from a wood-fired pizza truck. Plus, in Fort Lauderdale he enjoys Brazilian and Caribbean seafood dishes. S31, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Fillin' Up In Florence. Guy explores traditional Italian spots in Florence. First, he goes to a 50-year-old landmark with legendary spaghetti, before going to a popular pizza place. S22, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: International Appeal. Guy goes on an international culinary tour. In Stockton, he has an Asian rice noodle soup before heading to San Francisco for Puerto Rican and Cuban favourites. S24, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Bird And Beef. Guy is after awesome avian food and beef this trip, like the Dallas spot smoking both duck and brisket. In Phoenix, a Mexican place dishes out barbacoa and gorditas. S28, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Spinning The Globe. Guy Fieri is checking out eateries with global flavours. After a shocking twist on tacos in Kansas City, a food truck in Texas serves up meatless Mexican food. S30, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From Australian To Asian. Guy Fieri is on the lookout for worldwide flavours. In Kauai, a Japanese-Hawaiian eatery is putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos. S30, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Loaded, Stuffed And Fried. Guy Fieri visits joints loading it, stuffing it and frying it, from bison-gravy fries in Santa Fe, New Mexico to stuffed oysters in Kansas City, Kansas. S30, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Full Of Surprises. Guy Fieri digs into some surprising ingredients. In Santa Fe, a culinary pub serves lamb neck, and a Kansas City tapas joint dishes out duck tongue tacos! S30, Ep12

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Fishcakes, Linguine, Lamb Chops. Jamie Oliver cooks up quick Asian fishcakes with a sweet and spicy glaze. Then, he serves up lemon and courgette linguine and sticky lamb chops. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Lamb, Spaghetti, Fish, Cookies. Jamie cooks tender lamb shoulder with an easy cheat for maximum flavour. Plus, he prepares his speedy veggie spaghetti and apple crumble cookies. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Beef, Crispy Squid, Polenta Cake. Jamie prepares high-speed Ginger Shakin' Beef with pak choi. Then, he makes crispy squid and smashed avocado, plus almond, orange and polenta cake. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Pork Burger, Prawns, Gnocchi, Cheesecake. Jamie Oliver cooks pork burger, taking fast food to the next level! Later, he serves up sticky mango prawns and frozen banoffee cheesecake. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Thank You. Jamie cooks a summery feast of Mediterranean salmon, lemony potatoes and garlic roasted tomatoes. Plus, he serves up strawberry and prosecco cocktails. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Celebration. Jamie makes an incredible celebration meal of rainbow tomato crostini and roast lamb, finished off with strawberry panna cottas and mango caipirinhas. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Taco Party. Jamie creates a super-relaxed menu for a dynamite Mexican taco night. He makes slow-cooked pork belly with red cabbage slaw, and a chocolate semifreddo. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Picnic. Jamie serves up the ultimate picnic. He makes jam jar prawn cocktails, veggie quiches, a garlicky courgette and couscous salad, and tangerine drizzle cake. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Jamie prepares a vegetarian feast. Fragrant dishes include a coconut squash curry, fried golden paneer and a smoky aubergine dal, plus minted mango fro-yos. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Jamie reimagines steak and chips with steak and twice-cooked potatoes. Plus, he makes the perfect nibbles, including pesto on mozzarella toast. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Birmingham. James Martin hits the road in Great Britain, travelling Scotland, England, Wales and Northern Ireland on the ultimate culinary road trip. S1, Ep11

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Nottingham. James visits Nottingham, where he cooks a forest feast for Michelin award-winning restaurateur Sat Bains. Then, he whips up a tasty venison dish. S1, Ep12

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: 1988. Sci-fi Horror. Directed by John Carpenter. Stars Roddy Piper, Keith David & Meg Foster. A homeless drifter discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is.

programme.title: Climb Up the Wall
programme.desc: 1960. Musical & Variety. Directed by Michael Winner. Featuring performers such as George 'Calypso' Browne, Russ Conway and Frances Day.

programme.title: Up River
programme.desc: 1979. Drama. Murder, violence and greed haunt a young man's dream of forming a life from the untamed wilds of British Columbia at the turn of the century.

programme.title: That Beryl Marston!
programme.desc: Noel - Oh 'Ell. 1981. Comedy. Stars Julia McKenzie, Gareth Hunt & Jonathon Morris. Georgie tries to put a brave face on for Christmas as Auntie Vera and Uncle Fred arrive. (S1, E06)

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Gunslinger. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Starring Don Durant and Mark Goddard. Johnny is seriously wounded by an old enemy, one of the Brogger brothers.

programme.title: The Hills Of Donegal
programme.desc: 1947. Drama. Stars Irene Handle, John Bentley, Dinah Sheridan, James Etherington, Moore Marriott. Eileen is the star of an Irish operatic society but gives up to marry Terry O'Keefe.

programme.title: The Frightened Man
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Starring Dermot Walsh, Barbara Murray & Thora Hird. Julius (Walsh) is sent down from Oxford to join a gang of jewel thieves who plan a foolhardy raid.

programme.title: First Man Into Space
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Robert Day. Stars Marshall Thompson & Marla Landi. A U.S. Navy test pilot rockets himself into space but vanishes. Soon after, a blood thirsty creature appears on Earth.

programme.title: Landfall
